grh_af5955331e52542d7363.title: My Favorite Wife
paragraphs: After seven years missing at sea, Ellen Arden returns home on the very day her husband Nick has finally had her declared legally dead and married Bianca. Ellen tries to reclaim her place without immediately shattering the children or the new marriage, while Nick desperately searches for a legal and emotional way out of the absurd situation. Matters get worse when Nick learns Ellen spent the shipwreck years on an island with another man, provoking a new round of jealousy and concealment. The complications finally collapse under the truth, Bianca is released from the mistaken marriage, and Nick and Ellen reunite as husband and wife.

This [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] broadcast aired on December 7, 1950. It is listed as episode 80 in the archive. [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Cary Grant, Irene Dunne, Frank Nelson, Bob Hope, and Bing Crosby. Other credited names include Jimmy Wallington as announcer and Ken Carpenter as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 60 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.0ee8343bca2245d4|Chesterfield]] and [[org|org.47c43e9eb0213c63|RCA]].
This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.sdp.film.e57c2858ad2d6663|My Favorite Wife]].
